what: three to five short headlines running along the bottom of the scene band, with a label above them
use_when: a digest: several headlines of the day, or the story's context lines, that a viewer scans
avoid_when: one fact that must be read slowly, or a line longer than 48 characters
rules: "kicker": the line above the ticker (this brush draws it there, not at the top of the scene)
"headline": the lead above the running line, at most one line of 2-4 words; the items carry the rest
each item is one short headline with no closing full stop; three to five, in the order they should pass
